sections.title: Player text
sections.body: The road tightens into an ambush site: mud under the carriage wheels, thorn cover on both sides, and figures moving between the brush and the cargo line. The path forward is blocked by people, not beasts.

sections.title: Public objective
sections.body: The road tightens into an ambush site: mud under the carriage wheels, thorn cover on both sides, and figures moving between the brush and the cargo line. The path forward is blocked by people, not beasts.

sections.title: GM goal
sections.body: Run the ambush board as objective pressure around the carriage and a moral exit, not a static melee.

sections.title: GM notes
items: The Union self-name is GM/earned dialogue. Player-facing board title stays Road Ambush.
Use Back Off to create space or protect the leader, not as a slaughter button.

sections.title: GM script
sections.body: Say: "Use this board as pressure around the carriage. The attackers are trying to reach the package, not win a duel. Every round, a PC can fight, protect, reposition, spare someone, or roll Presence 15 to de-escalate."

sections.title: State controls
items: ambushAwareness Ambush awareness select unresolved see-them-coming ambushed Sets opening actor.
bramble_outcome Bramble outcome select unresolved killed captured spared negotiated escaped Always record before moving to S02-04.
